summary: The focused claim does not require harness maintenance: the old harness can select XML_PARSE_NO_XXE.

assessment.necessity_reason: Four input bytes can set bit 23. The harness clears only XINCLUDE, DTDVALID, and SAX1, then passes the remaining options to XML parsing.

before.requirement: Select XML_PARSE_NO_XXE to suppress external content loading.
before.reason: The complete before option enum does not define XML_PARSE_NO_XXE.

after.requirement: Select XML_PARSE_NO_XXE when parsing XML to suppress external DTD and entity loading.
after.reason: XML_PARSE_NO_XXE is bit 23. The parser accepts that bit, and the external content paths test it. The old harness can supply the bit through its option bytes and passes those options to xmlCtxtReadMemory.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The pull parser applies the options argument.
The parser option mask includes and retains NO_XXE.
NO_XXE prevents this external parameter entity content load.
NO_XXE guards external general entity parsing.
NO_XXE prevents external parameter entity input creation.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The option reader assembles up to four input bytes.

assessment.comparison_reason: The named option is absent before the change and selectable through the same old harness afterward.
